_provenance: Subject list matches the subjects explicitly used elsewhere in this project's data (shared/engineeringTerminology.json) and named in product requirements — Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Physics, Engineering Chemistry, Basic Electrical Engineering, Programming for Problem Solving, Engineering Graphics, Engineering Workshop Practice, English/Communication, plus Environmental Sciences and Scientific Programming which already had real term data in this repo. This repository does not contain a separate official syllabus document, so unit/topic groupings below were constructed by clustering the existing, real engineeringTerminology.json term set into the standard topic organization used by JNTU-affiliated engineering curricula (which this project's existing subject list and university branding already reflect) — not copied from an external syllabus PDF. Every 'terms' array below is a closed, exact-match list of real term names that exist in shared/engineeringTerminology.json; frontend/src/utils/topicTerms.js hard-fails in dev if any listed term does not resolve, so this file cannot silently drift out of sync with the term dataset.
